self_audit: Pooled average rank U_A identity agrees with oriented pair semantics and exact ties.
Signed comparator handles DATA_W minimum/maximum without magnitude conversion.
PAIR_W represents 2*floor(MAX_LEN^2/4); signed AW adds an explicit sign bit for C-L and positive denominator.
Overcapacity freezes retained prefix and suppresses all statistic outputs; final missing-group errors use the retained prefix.
RAM words are overwritten before future scans, the current sample is excluded, and reset cancels all reachable control phases.
Tail schedule checked after NBA on every main frame; real input/output stalls observed.
